ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
vxe: uxe' — its foot, its base; u- 'its' + xe' 'root, foot' · uxe' — its root, its beginning (of an account)
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
vhul: ujul — his hole; u- 'his' + jul 'hole, pit'
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard') · ta — after mawi, marks the negation (mawi utz ta chuxoq 'it is not good that it be'); particle
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
zipacna: Sipakna — Zipacna; name of the elder son of Vucub Caquix; meaning not clear
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find')
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you')
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik
nah: naj — far; adverb (chi nah 'from far off')
xcah: xqaj — it went down; x- completive + qaj 'descend' · xkaj — they wanted; x- completive + k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', as in xraj 'he wanted'
qui: ki — their; 3pl possessive/ergative prefix · ki — k- 'ongoing' + i- 'you (pl.)', written qui like the prefix 'their'; also k- + i(n) 'I' (inferred)
lo: lo — perhaps; particle, as in k'o wi lo · saw (uncertain), in xki lo 'they saw it'; a verb not otherwise known, sense inferred from Brasseur
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
caib: ka'ib' — two; numeral, ka'- with -ib' (the root of ukab' 'its second' and ukab'al 'the second')
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads')
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
vla: ula — hither, coming; adverb with verbs of coming
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition · chi — ch- (command) + i- 'you (pl.)', before a verb
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
ꜭaholab: k'ajolab' — boys, young men; k'ajol 'son, young man' + plural -ab'
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
tana: tana — meaning not known; not otherwise explained
racuh: rakuj — scrape (inferred); with uchi' 'his mouth', 'cry out' (Brasseur, word for word 'scrape his mouth'); form inferred
xecha: xecha — they said; x- completive + e- 'they' + cha 'say'
quibil: kib'il — (to) themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + ib' 'self' + -il, in chi kib'il kib' 'among themselves'
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive · qib' — ourselves; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + ib' reflexive
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
apanoc: apanoq — later, in time (guess); not otherwise known
xuꜩinic: xutzinik — it came right, succeeded; x- completive + utzin 'succeed, complete' (from utz 'good') + -ik
xca: xqa — we (did it); x- completive + qa- 'we', subject of a transitive verb
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e
xcamic: xkamik — he died; x- completive + kam 'die' + -ik
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain · la — you, Your Lordship, a respectful form (chi la 'to you'; inferred from Brasseur's note); particle
cuꜭ: kuk' — with them; ruk' 'with him' with 3pl prefix · quk' — with us; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uk' 'company'
omuch: omuch — four hundred; numeral, twenty twenties
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
cul: kul — it comes; k- 'ongoing' + ul 'come, arrive here'
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
xquibih: xkib'ij — they said, they spoke; x- completive + ki- 'they' + b'ij 'say' (the byih of xchicabyih)
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line
xquil: xkil — they saw; x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see', without the -o of xkilo
xuꜩin: xutzin — it succeeded, came right; x- completive + utzin
ꜭaxtoꜭ: k'axtok' — demon, deceiver; noun, the colonial word for the devil
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle
v: u — its; possessive prefix (Ximénez writes v), as in v xe 'its root'
conohel: konojel — all of them; ki- 'their' made k- before a vowel + onojel, as ronojel is r- + onojel
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
mahabi: majab'i — there is not, not yet; negative particle
xcolotah: xkolotaj — he was saved (inferred); kol 'save' + -otaj, as in xcolo 'was freed'
vꜭahol: uk'ajol — his son; u- 'his' + k'ajol 'son, young man'
caquix: Kaqix — Macaw (in Seven Macaw), the scarlet macaw; noun
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki-
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
vchacatahic: uchakatajik — his being brought low; u- 'his' + chakataj (the verb of xchacatahic, inferred 'bring low') + -ik, verbal noun (sense inferred)
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
hutaꜫih: jutaq'ij — every day; jun 'one' + taq 'each' + q'ij 'day'
ꜫih: q'ij — day, sun; noun (Ratit Q'ij 'Grandmother of the Day'); in ki q'ij 'their day' perhaps 'their lot, fortune' (uncertain)
recha: recha — his food; r- 'his' before a vowel + echa 'food'
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun · uwach — its fruit (the face a tree shows); noun
tac: taq — plural marker 'various, several'; particle placed before a noun
quechelah: k'echelaj — forest; a second spelling of quichelah (k'iche'laj): k'iche' 'many trees' + -laj
xuxic: xuxik — they came to be; x- completive + ux 'become' + -ik
vcoc: ukok — its going in (inferred, doubtful reading); taken with ok 'enter', the c not explained (Brasseur x-uq-oc)
ꜫab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun (ki q'ab' 'their hands')
vva: uwa — its face (the face of the sky, va for vach, Brasseur's note); u- 'its' + wa(ch) 'face'
chuxe: chuxe' — at the foot of; chu- (chi + u- 'its') + xe' 'root, foot'
apa: apa — where; interrogative adverb, asks the place
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
ꜭahol: k'ajol — son, child (of a man); noun
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'
rico: riqo — they found; root riq 'find'; xe riqo kib' 'they found each other', i.e. agreed (exact form uncertain) · riqo — find, in chu riqo 'let it find' (ch- + u- 'it')
chin: chin — I shall (inferred); ch- 'what is to come' + in 'I', before a verb
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb
re: re — of, belonging to; relational particle · re — his teeth; r- 'his' + e 'tooth'
tala: tala — (uncertain) meaning not known; the letters kept
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred)
xrah: xraj — wanted; x- completive + r- 'he, it' (3sg ergative before a vowel) + aj 'want', the wanted action following as a noun
on: on — perhaps; particle (in xa on 'only perhaps')
ba: b'a — particle of urging; not otherwise explained
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative) · taj — the second part of the negative ma ... taj 'not' (ma nab'e ki chakatajik taj 'not first their being brought low')
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow')
xuculu: Xukulu — unknown word (uncertain); printed as one word, left untranslated
